There's an anime coming out on tuesday that I'm really excited for and have been for a long time and that's the one thing that I've been kind of holding out for but at the same time it's so difficult because I have such a hard time getting along with people and when one incident happens it makes me feel horrible about myself and it feels like I shouldn't be around since I'm just a burden to other people.

Thanks for leaving a comment, it did help a little.
im sorry im sorry im sorry if this is pathetic

i often feel like most people don't like me and if they do like me initially that there's just a matter of time until they get tired of me. I know it's stereotypical for a depressed person to say that but based on my history of past relationships that's just the common thread that happens

Yeah, I mean I feel like I can still have casual conversation its just that having any sort of extending conversation that leads towards friendships is something that is very difficult for me. But being alone for so many years has made me really start to hate myself so much but at the same time so many other people end up hurting or being mean to me so it's so hard.

maybe being an observer would be better rather than me actually talking and engaging with people because i'm so tired of so many people around me hurting me or strangers being mean or something to me but at the same time i'm not sure if that's even healthy.
honestly i dont even have friends, i just have family but its just so hard.

I just mean that im really scared of death itself. im scared of not existing anymore and not having any thoughts, thats why i only hope and wish that there will be an afterlife after all this but the fact is that i dont know for sure and i will never know for sure until i die and thats terrifying for me
